programs.title: Agent-Run Workplaces: Reading the Coordination Floor
outcomes: Explain how agent teams assign and execute work through surfaces like Slack and Linear
Identify which decisions must remain with humans under a reserved-actions list
Draft questions for bargaining over agent-assisted workflows

sessions.activity: Read a live Goal Wall and rewrite a workplace goal in measurable terms agents could track.
Trace how messages and status updates flow across surfaces; map where worker input enters the loop.
Audit sample assignments: who holds what work, how reassignment happens, and where humans can intervene.
Compare agent-drafted decisions with the human-only final vote; role-play a steward review.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized session reflections on task-assignment clarity, tagged by role type, contribute to a shared model of human-readable agent coordination.
programs.consent: Participation is voluntary; reflections are de-identified before upload and workers may opt out of data contribution without losing access to training.

programs.title: Lagoon Campus of Robot Teams
outcomes: Describe an agent team as Goal Keeper, Coordinator, Assigner and Executor roles
Distinguish agent work from human-only decisions
Build a paper goal wall and assignment board for a class project

sessions.activity: Write a class goal for the campus lagoon cleanup and post it where every team can read it.
Break the goal into tasks and assign them across small teams, tracking who holds what.
Pass status updates between teams using message cards, mimicking Slack-style coordination.
Discuss which choices agents may draft but only people vote on; hold a class vote by secret ballot.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized examples of student goal statements and assignment boards help build a shared library of clear task language.
programs.consent: Guardian/parent consent is obtained in writing before any student work is collected; only de-identified samples are shared and families may withdraw at any time.

programs.title: Coordinated Agents for Field Programs
outcomes: Map an NGO program onto Goal Wall, Assignment Board and Execution Bay workflows
Design escalation paths that keep final decisions with human stewards
Assess readiness gaps before delegating work to agent teams

sessions.activity: Translate one real program objective into a measurable, agent-trackable goal statement.
Sketch task breakdown and ownership for the goal, marking which tasks need human sign-off.
Walk through execution-with-reporting and identify check-in points and blocker reporting.
Draft an escalation protocol: agent drafts, evidence attached, human stewards vote.

programs.data_shared: De-identified goal statements and workflow maps contribute to a shared library of program-design patterns for agent-assisted coordination.
programs.consent: Staff opt in per program; no beneficiary or field data is shared, and drafts are anonymized before contributing to shared models.

programs.title: Stewardship by Design: Governing Agent Teams
outcomes: Explain the reserved-actions line and why final votes and enactment stay with humans
Draft governance language for supervising agent-executed operations
Set review cadences and audit trails for agent-assigned work

sessions.activity: Review the reserved-actions list and draft board-level oversight language for agent decisions.
Audit a sample assignment log for traceability and accountability to beneficiaries.
Align a mission statement with a measurable goal an agent team can track without overstepping.
Design audit checkpoints where executed work is reported back before any human-reserved action.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized governance templates and oversight checklists join a shared stewardship library for mission-aligned agent operations.
programs.consent: Board-approved data-sharing policy governs contributions; all templates are scrubbed of identifying details and donors' or clients' information is never included.
